stemMd: A researcher finds that firms using a forecasting service have fewer inventory shortages. She concludes that adopting the service would reduce shortages for any firm. Which objection best identifies a flaw?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The conclusion does not name every forecasting technique.

options.label: C
options.textMd: All firms must have identical products.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Firms choosing the service may already differ in management practices that reduce shortages.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Forecasts necessarily predict the future perfectly.

explanationMd: Self-selection can produce the observed association. Better-managed firms may both adopt the service and avoid shortages, so adoption alone is not established as the cause.

distractorRationale.e: That is false and not a premise of the critique.
distractorRationale.c: The objection need not assume identical products.
distractorRationale.b: Exhaustive naming is not required for a valid causal argument.
